$comment: Part I Section A — XML mapping for the publication reference. Maps the instance-data publication fields to UBL cac:AdditionalDocumentReference. The DocumentTypeCode attribute set comes from the ESPD 5.0.0 Schematron (01-ESPD-common-cl-attributes.sch, line 74), validated against DocrefcontentType.gc version 20250319-0.

rules.$comment: Notice identifier → AdditionalDocumentReference/ID. @schemeAgencyID is mandatory and non-empty on EVERY cbc:ID (BR-OTH-02, fatal). The publication identifier has no agency field in the instance model, so the maintaining agency is a constant: 'OP' (the EU Publications Office, which assigns TED notice numbers). This mirrors how the other administrative identifiers carry @schemeAgencyID.
Publication type → AdditionalDocumentReference/DocumentTypeCode (DocrefcontentType codelist). The codelist attribute set is expanded by expandCodelistAttributes at validation time.
Optional notice URL → Attachment/ExternalReference/URI. Note the ExternalReference nesting — the Slovenian XML confirms this; the EA model's direct Attachment/URI is wrong.
